title: Submission of Life Insurance Data to IIB, Nov 2016.pdf399 KB
full_text:
**INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 

is drawn to the circular ref: IRDA/SDD/MISC/228/11/2014, dt.19/11/2014 on above subject which mandated submission of data to 11B at half yearly frequency. The same has been reviewed based on representation received with regard to difficulties experienced submission of data every six months. in partial modification to the circular, all the life insurers are hereby directed to submit 11B only on yearly basis and not on half yearly basis as stated in the above mentioned
